title: Rational restricted Fourier weight observation
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $J$ be a finite set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates, let $S\subseteq J$, let $z$ assign a sign to each coordinate outside $J$, and let $y,y'$ assign signs to coordinates in $J$. For signs $a,a'$, the rational restricted Fourier weight observation is the product of the rational Fourier observation at the lifted frequency determined by $S$ for the combined inputs $(y,z)$ and output $a$, and the corresponding observation for $(y',z)$ and output $a'$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite subset of the $n$ coordinates
caveat: The definitions of lifted frequency, combined sign cube, and rational Fourier observation are not included, so the factors cannot be given a more explicit mathematical interpretation.
